breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not include the incorrect instruction that torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. Instead, it correctly instructs to compute τ = Tc/J (which is maximal at the outer surface) and uses it in the plane stress analysis with τxy = τ, matching the ground truth.
